name: Astro Wars
desc:
On board of your spacecraft, destroy the Invaders!
A laser beam helps you to destroy these formidable enemies!
Will you reach the end of your dangerous mission? It would be better, because your life and that of the Earth depends!

name: Astro Wars 2 - Battle In Galaxy
file: Astro Wars II - Battle in Galaxy (Japan).zip
desc: The second part of Astro Wars, which takes place in space. This is a Galaxian style game, whereas the first is an Invaders style game.

name: Boulder Dash
desc: The ultimate underground journey, but be forewarned - nothing less than perfection is required! Boulder Dash will challenge your mind and reflexes like no other game. The objective is to search throughout each cave and collect as many jewels in as short a time as possible. Once the indicated amount has been collected, the door to the mysterious escape tunnel is revealed and you go to the next level. Boulders drop predictably enough, but you and Rockford also have to block growing amoebas, transform butterflies, outmaneuver fireflies, and overcome other numerous obstacles.

name: Comic Circus
desc: You end up at the Circus with a friend and you have to try to catch balloons hanging from the top of a rope using a springboard that will make you flutter. You also have to catch bags dropped by pigeons. During the second phase, the jump is made on a trampolino and in the third phase you have to hang on to the trapeze artists to catch the pigeons. If you do not catch up the jumper, he will fall to the ground and you will lose any chance of winning. There are different stages available. For one to four people who can play together.

name: Doraemon
desc: It is notable for being the first Doraemon game to feature the whole main cast, as well as the second Doraemon game ever developed, the first being Doraemon for the Arcadia 2001.

name: Elevator Fight
desc: Arin, your space suit-clad hero, must travel downwards in shaft of 31 floors populated by dangerous robots, space mice and aliens and filled with traps, in order to destroy the central computer of the Gashim empire on the bottom floor. The shaft is divided in a multitude of floors, connected by lifts. Both you and your enemies may use the lifts, using them both to advance, to escape and to ambush. The enemies have different behaviours, with some rushing toward you and some shooting. Traps include grappling claws and lasers in the ceilings and electrical floors. For defence, you have a gun.

name: Lupin III
desc: This adventure takes place successively in an underground, in a cave, and in the jungle. You are LUPINE III and you run in search of diamonds. But beware, crocodiles, vultures, snakes, tree trunks are chasing you. One thing to do: jump over them or destroy them. During the fourth phase, you are in a room in which you have to shoot at moving targets in order to be able to escape. So hurry yourself and don't waste a minute, because time is precious. For one or two players.

name: Milky Princess
desc: Game delivered with a particular version of the Epoch Super Cassette called "the Super Cassette Vision Lady's". The goal is to predict the future! To give credit to the title, Epoch linked the name of René Van Dale Watanabe (a famous astrologer) to the game.

name: Miner 2049er
desc: The player controls Bounty Bob, a character who explores the depths of an underground mine in a radioactive future. He can scratch the ground as he walks and must dodge or crush the irradiated monsters that walk by him. The levels are made of beams, ladders, sliding platforms and teleporters. The player must scrape each piece of ground to reach the next level. The game has ten or eleven levels depending on the version.

name: Nebula
desc: You are on the Planet NEBULA during the time of the Pharaohs in 2019. A thousand of pitfalls await you and the Gods see you when you approach their tombs. Can you use your laser beams and homing bombs to destroy them? Make no mistake, because it will be fatal! Contains four levels for one or two players.

name: Nekketsu Kung Fu Road
desc: M. CHEN, master of KUNG FU, hates the members of the TUE family, made of brutal and unscrupulous personnes. Learning that his fiancée's father has been killed by the TUE Chief, he burns to avenge her. Thanks to his mastery of KUNG FU, help Mr. CHEN get to his enemy's castle, having triumphed over his henchmen, vase throwers, giants, steel stars and bulls all standing in his way. Then defeat the TUE Leader to win. For 1 or 2 players. Also includes a possibility of combat between 2 Players.

name: Pole Position 2
desc: In Pole Position II, based on the arcade sequel to Pole Position, you are again driving an F-1 racer in a timed qualifying run, trying to achieve the pole position. Then it is off to the race, in hopes of taking that top spot. The difference in Pole...

name: Pop And Chips
desc:
The adventure of Pop and Chips begins with the fairy Pippi, who has been kidnapped by Pumpkin the Great.
There are blocks that can be broken and blocks that cannot be broken on the screen. When you break the fruit block, Pippi appears and moves up and down on the screen, and when you go around and back to the original position, he returns to the original fruit block.
If you touch Pippi, he will be collected at the top left of the screen.
Once you return to the fruit, the movement will be faster from the second time. Clear the screen by collecting all the pippi.

name: Punch Boy
desc: Armed with a mini-punch, the main character, "Punch Boy," goes through a maze of various gimmicks to "Monster Castle," defeats four "bosses," and saves the captured "Lady." In the maze, monsters are born from rock-like eggs (which can be rolled with a punch). The monster does not accept mini punches from other than the front, faints with the mini punch from the front, and can be defeated with another blow. Some eggs do not hatch, and monsters and punch boys often roll eggs (1 down even if crushed by rolling eggs).

name: Rantou Pro-wrestling
desc:
In single combat, or in 4-man wrestling, you must defeat your opponent according to the rules of the art:
Cuffs, arm locks, throws or immobilizations are part of the technique of the champion you choose.

name: Real Graphic Mahjongg
desc: Mahjong is a tile-based game that was developed during the Qing dynasty in China and has spread throughout the world since the early 20th century.The game is played with a set of 144 tiles based on Chinese characters and symbols, although some regional variations may omit some tiles or add unique ones. In most variations, each player begins by receiving 13 tiles. In turn players draw and discard tiles until they complete a legal hand using the 14th drawn tile to form four melds (or sets) and a pair (eye). A player can also win with a small class of special hands.

name: Shogi Nyuumon
desc: The objective of the game is to take the opposing king. When the king cannot avoid being caught on the next move, the game is over. They say the king is "Matt". The shogi opposes two players who take turns playing. The Shogi chess board is called Shogi Ban ("Shogi table") and has 81 squares (9 x 9), the three rows furthest from the players constituting their promotion area. At the start of the game each player has 20 pieces: a king, a rook, a bishop, two gold generals, two silver generals, two horsemen, two spears, and nine pawns.

name: Super Base Ball
desc: It is a relatively orthodox system for an early baseball game, and the basic operation method is not much different from that of subsequent family stadiums (there are also changing balls and ball speed adjustments). It has some pioneering features as a baseball game of the pre-Family era.

name: Super Golf
desc: The course has 18 holes and a total length of 5,805 meters. You have to get the ball into the hole with a minimum of strokes, despite the wind and many obstacles. You can choose the club, the direction and the force with which the ball will be sent. Challenge your friends, one to four people can play together.

name: Super Sansuu Puter
desc:
Arithmetic learning software for kindergarten children to sixth graders . It inherits the name of the company's electronic game , Sun Pewter .
You can learn math like a game by using the numeric keypad on the main unit. The pause key on the main unit is diverted as a button for entering the decimal point, but the pause key on the SCV is essentially a semi-forced pause button, and such diversion is rare.

name: Super Soccer
desc: Find yourself facing your opponents on a football stadium! You can dribble, pass, shoot, or send the ball with your head. You can control the trajectory of the ball and the length of each pass. You can also shoot corners, free kicks and penalties. For one or two players.

name: Tonton Ball
desc: A billiard- style pinball game with action elements . Clear the surface when you finish putting Tonton in the house within the time limit.

name: Wheelie Racer
desc: Take part in three rallies in America, Africa and Europe behind the wheel of your car. Be aware of dangerous turns, damaged cars, puddles. Also monitor your fuel level and don't forget to stop at a pump if necessary. You have to overtake other cars and avoid rocks and tree trunks as well as trucks that get in the middle of the road. A game full of surprises along the way. Be the best Driver and good chance for the first prize.
